mode: Segment full unpadded recording once, intersect intervals with candidate crops; no detector result inspected to choose VAD parameters
clarification_to_design: Whole-recording context is used, not separately resetting VAD for every crop. Padding is never fed into VAD. All policies are offline, not latency claims.
subset: Common file mask: start and middle speech fractions>=0.8 at BOTH 1s and 2s, with within-duration absolute fraction difference<=0.1.
policy: At each duration choose greatest VAD speech fraction among 9 relative offsets; tie selects earliest source offset; no label/score-based tuning
